rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact schedule change: earlier recurrent tail blocks now start near zero and ramp in with a quadratic curriculum, while the last tail block stays fully active. This spends more of the 600s budget on stabilizing the non-recurrent path early, then phases recurrence back in later without adding export bytes or runtime shape churn.
title: Zero-Start Reverse-Tail Curriculum
